newsitem.title: PERU: Peru details planned 1997 foreign debt payments.
newsitem.headline: Peru details planned 1997 foreign debt payments.

text.p: Peruvian Economy Minister Jorge Camet said the government planned to service its foreign debt by making 1.715 billion soles in principal payments and 2.257 billion soles in interest payments during 1997.
The total, 3.972 billion soles, would represent 16 percent of the proposed 1997 budget of 24.765 billion soles.
The government also estimates that next year its total debt servicing - including its domestic debt payments - will cost 4.619 billion soles, accounting for 18.7 percent of the budget.
The government's budget has projected an average exchange rate of 2.70 soles to the dollar in 1997, up from the current rate of 2.485 soles.
